purpose: Pinned discovery registries and workflow references from the public Census Dashboard Kit. Source-address preflight inputs are not evidence of acquisition, content verification, geography matching or indicator adoption; workflow references are not evidence that an audit was performed.

registries.use: Priority-country identity and JICA supervising-office context only; do not replace the UN M49 world registry.
Discovery addresses for national statistics, planning, geography and international candidates; refresh and inspect originals in every country task.
Detailed reference cases for Dominican Republic, Uganda, Laos and Bangladesh; never copy country-specific laws, hierarchy or indicators to another country.

workflow_sources.use: Independent read-only completion audit after the builder closes a country candidate; do not publish before ACCEPT.
